name: Patrick Schramowski

affiliations.role: Researcher; lead author on Safe Latent Diffusion and LlavaGuard

bio: Patrick Schramowski is a researcher at DFKI and the AIML Lab at TU Darmstadt, working on safety and human-centered generative AI. Schramowski is first author of Safe Latent Diffusion and a senior author of LlavaGuard, a vision-language model framework for safeguarding datasets and models.
known_for: First author of Safe Latent Diffusion
